hero.subtitle: When a Riverbank collision takes a family member, the days that follow are overwhelming. LawProactive can connect you, at no cost, with an independent attorney familiar with wrongful death claims arising from crashes on roads like Patterson Road and Rt 108.

about.title: Riverbank Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Stanislaus County recorded a traffic death alongside 103 injury collisions and 155 injured people in the most recent final year of data, and Riverbank's own corridors — Patterson Road, Oakdale Road, Claribel Road, and Rt 108 — carry much of that reported activity, with Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. seeing more crashes than other times. Behind every one of those counts is a family that may now be facing funeral arrangements, lost income, and an absence no paperwork can fill. California law allows a narrow group of survivors — spouses, domestic partners, and children first, with other dependents or heirs in certain situations — to pursue a wrongful death claim separate from any criminal proceedings. LawProactive doesn't practice law; we simply connect grieving families in Riverbank with an independent personal injury attorney who can explain options, deadlines, and what losses may be recoverable, all at no upfront cost.

items.title: Only Certain Survivors Can File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to spouses, domestic partners, and children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible under specific circumstances. An attorney can help clarify who in your family qualifies.

items.title: The Clock Is Running
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity is involved. Waiting too long can close off options entirely.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: California law recognizes funeral costs and lost financial support, but also the loss of love, companionship, and guidance a family member provided. These non-economic losses are part of what a claim can address.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Priority goes to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing depending on the family's circumstances. An independent attorney can review your situation and explain where you fit.

items.question: How long do we have to file after losing someone in a Riverbank crash?
items.answer: Generally, California gives families two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. That deadline is shorter if a government agency, such as one responsible for a road like Oakdale Road or Claribel Road, is involved, so it's worth talking with an attorney sooner rather than later.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim connected to any criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action focused on compensating the family, regardless of whether criminal charges are filed or how they turn out. The two processes run independently of each other.
